display_long_description:
Claim Your Name is a thrilling single-player VR carnival experience where skill, precision, and high scores decide who rises to the top. Step into a vibrant virtual arcade filled with exciting challenges, immersive environments, and intense score-based gameplay designed to test every player’s abilities.
Players begin their journey by entering their unique player name before purchasing a special game ticket pack. Each player receives 6 individual game tickets and 1 special bonus ticket. Every individual ticket grants access to one of the six unique carnival mini-games, while the special ticket allows players to replay any one game of their choice for a final chance to increase their score and climb the rankings.
The game features six exciting VR mini-games, each focused on different gameplay mechanics and physical interaction:
• Shooting Challenge
 • Basketball Challenge
 • Point Ball Challenge
 • Archery Challenge
 • Ladder Challenge
 • Ring Toss Challenge
Every game rewards players with points based on performance, accuracy, speed, and skill. Players must complete all six games to unlock the special bonus ticket. Once unlocked, the special ticket can be used strategically to replay a favorite game and earn even more points.
At the end of all seven plays, the player’s total score is calculated and submitted to the in-game leaderboard. Only the Top 5 highest-scoring players can secure a place on the leaderboard, making every point important. Players can see their names updated
